name: Ironbeard's Tomb
summary: Black and crimson oozes foul Ironbeard's Tomb beside the road north to Dun Modr. Travelers search the slime for possessions swallowed in the graveyard.

sections.title: A Befouled Resting Place
sections.body: Beside the road north to Dun Modr, Ironbeard's Tomb overlooks the marshes. A great stone statue, believed to show Ironbeard, watches over the burial plot. Black and crimson oozes now overrun the crypt below and foul the resting place. Dwarves no longer bring their dead here. Those who enter the vaults search among remains swallowed by the slimes.

faq.answer: Little is recorded about Ironbeard. The statue and crypt suggest he was an honored dwarf in the Wetlands, and his likeness watches over the hillside above the cemetery.
Acidic black and crimson oozes have overrun the crypt. The burial grounds are defiled and dangerous, so mourning families no longer bring their dead here.

faq.q: Why do adventurers explore Ironbeard's Tomb?
faq.answer: Travelers search the slimes for swallowed possessions, especially Sida's lost bag, while fighting back the infestation.

aliases: how to get to ironbeard tomb
faq.answer: Ironbeard's Tomb sits in a hill in north-central Wetlands, just west of the main road north toward Dun Modr.

angles.text: As a dwarf, seeing a clan hero's resting place infested by mindless marsh oozes is a bitter disgrace on the road toward the Thandol Span.
